# AiUdio Server

> Self-hosted TTS/STT gateway (FastAPI): two interchangeable TTS engines (Qwen3-TTS,
> Chatterbox), streaming STT proxy (NeMo-Speech.cpp) and an STT → external LLM → TTS
> conversation loop. The web UI is a demo/admin front; the HTTP/WebSocket API is the
> integration contract. Runs via Docker Compose.

- Base URL (default): http://localhost:8004
- Discovery: GET /api/capabilities (families, routes, WS message names) · OpenAPI: /openapi.json · docs: /docs
- Auth: HTTP Basic (admin) + API keys (X-API-Key / Bearer / ?api_key=). Reads/synthesis accept any client key; writes (settings/models/voices/STT downloads) require an admin
- WebSocket protocols (ws/tts, ws/chat, ws/stt) are not in OpenAPI: see docs/api.md; runnable clients in examples/ (incl. STT file + realtime)
- Makefile: `make test`, `make lint`, `make up`

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): overview, quick start, env vars, troubleshooting.
- [docs/integration.md](docs/integration.md): how to integrate another application (REST, OpenAI-compatible, PCM streaming, WebSockets, latency tips).
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): route and field reference.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): components and request flows.
- [docs/backends.md](docs/backends.md): hardware backends and the isolated Chatterbox venv.
- [docs/conversation.md](docs/conversation.md): STT → LLM → TTS cascade.
- [docs/security.md](docs/security.md): authentication, API keys, SSRF/hardening.
- [docs/realtime.md](docs/realtime.md): latency analysis and real-time roadmap.

## Agent / integration entry points

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the integration contract, checklist and repo rules for AI agents.
- [examples/](examples): runnable Python, Node and curl clients.
